// ==UserScript==
// @name         Zer0xProject 2.1
// @description  Глобальный релиз с полной совместимостью, тгк:mineenergyfun
// @namespace    http://tampermonkey.net/
// @version      2.1
// @match        https://me1.mineenergy2.fun/*
// @require      https://unpkg.com/msgpack-lite@0.1.26/dist/msgpack.min.js
// @run-at       document-start
// @grant        none
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
    'use strict';

    // --- СТИЛИ И ШРИФТЫ ---
const styleFont = document.createElement('style');
styleFont.innerHTML = `
    @font-face {
        font-family: 'Minecraft';
src: url('data:font/truetype;charset=utf-8;base64,') format('truetype');
}
`;
document.head.appendChild(styleFont);
    document.head.appendChild(styleFont);

    const defaultConfig = {
        font: 'cursive',
        customFontUrl: '',
        bgColor: '#181818',
        textColor: '#ffffff',
        accentColor: '#87CEEB',
        menuScale: 1.0,
        speedHack: false,
        adBlock: true,
        freePlace: false,
        zoom: true,
        hideShopIcon: false,
        hideTopText: false
    };

    function loadConfig() {
        try {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('zer0x_client_config');
            if (saved) {
                return { ...defaultConfig, ...JSON.parse(saved) };
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        return { ...defaultConfig };
    }

    let currentConfig = loadConfig();

    if (currentConfig.customFontUrl) {
        const customStyle = document.createElement('style');
        customStyle.innerHTML = `
            @font-face {
                font-family: 'UserCustomFont';
                src: url('${currentConfig.customFontUrl}') format('truetype');
            }
        `;
        document.head.appendChild(customStyle);
    }

    function getActiveFontFamily() {
        if (currentConfig.font === 'custom' && currentConfig.customFontUrl) {
            return 'UserCustomFont';
        }
        if (currentConfig.font === 'minecraft') {
            return 'MinecraftCustom';
        }
        return currentConfig.font;
    }

    // --- СКРЫТИЕ ЭЛЕМЕНТОВ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА ---
    function applyCustomHiding() {
        const allElements = document.querySelectorAll('span, div, p');
        allElements.forEach(el => {
            const text = el.innerText || '';
            if (currentConfig.hideTopText) {
                if ((text.includes('Продавайте энергию') || text.includes('Генераторы вырабатывают')) && el.children.length === 0) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                    if (el.parentElement && el.parentElement.innerText.length < 150) {
                        el.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (text.includes('Продавайте энергию')) {
                    el.style.display = '';
                    if (el.parentElement) el.parentElement.style.display = '';
                }
            }

            if (currentConfig.hideShopIcon) {
                if (text.toLowerCase() === 'магазин' || (el.tagName === 'IMG' && (el.src.includes('shop') || el.src.includes('store')))) {
                    el.style.display = 'none';
                    if (el.parentElement && el.parentElement.className.includes('button')) {
                        el.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (text.toLowerCase() === 'магазин') {
                    el.style.display = '';
                    if (el.parentElement) el.parentElement.style.display = '';
                }
            }
        });
    }

    const hidingObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        applyCustomHiding();
    });

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        if (document.body) {
            hidingObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
            applyCustomHiding();
        }
    });

    // --- ИГРОВЫЕ МЕХАНИКИ (ZOOM & FREEPLACE) ---
    let zoomEnabled = currentConfig.zoom;

    window.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        if (!zoomEnabled) return;

        if (window.GAME && window.GAME.canvas && window.GAME.canvas.camera) {
            const gameCameraManager = window.GAME.canvas.camera;
            let targetMultiplier = gameCameraManager.cameraVerticalPositionMultiply;

            if (typeof targetMultiplier !== 'number') targetMultiplier = 2.21;

            if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                targetMultiplier *= 1.15;
            } else {
                targetMultiplier /= 1.15;
            }

            targetMultiplier = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(100.0, targetMultiplier));
            gameCameraManager.cameraVerticalPositionMultiply = targetMultiplier;

            e.stopPropagation();
        }
    }, { capture: true, passive: true });

    let freePlaceEnabled = currentConfig.freePlace;

    function freePlaceLoop() {
        try {
            if (window.GAME && window.GAME.modules && window.GAME.modules.mod && window.GAME.modules.mod.cursor) {
                window.GAME.modules.mod.cursor._cellSize = freePlaceEnabled ? 1 : 64;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        requestAnimationFrame(freePlaceLoop);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(freePlaceLoop);

    // --- УПРАВЛЕНИЕ И ДВИЖЕНИЕ ---
    window.activeGameWorkers = [];

    const BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED = 150;
    const SHIFT_INITIAL_JUMP = 300;
    const SHIFT_ACCELERATION = 5;
    const SHIFT_DECELERATION = 20;

    let currentSpeed = BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED;
    let isShiftHeld = false;
    let speedHackEnabled = currentConfig.speedHack;

    const keys = {
        w: false, a: false, s: false, d: false,
        arrowup: false, arrowleft: false, arrowdown: false, arrowright: false
    };

    function mapKey(e) {
        const code = e.code;
        const key = e.key ? e.key.toLowerCase() : '';

        if (code === 'KeyW' || key === 'w' || key === 'ц') return 'w';
        if (code === 'KeyA' || key === 'a' || key === 'ф') return 'a';
        if (code === 'KeyS' || key === 's' || key === 'ы') return 's';
        if (code === 'KeyD' || key === 'd' || key === 'в') return 'd';

        if (code === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'arrowup') return 'arrowup';
        if (code === 'ArrowLeft' || key === 'arrowleft') return 'arrowleft';
        if (code === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'arrowdown') return 'arrowdown';
        if (code === 'ArrowRight' || key === 'arrowright') return 'arrowright';

        return null;
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
        if (e.code === 'Insert') return;
        if (e.key === "Shift" || e.code === "ShiftLeft" || e.code === "ShiftRight") isShiftHeld = true;
        const k = mapKey(e);
        if (k && keys.hasOwnProperty(k)) keys[k] = true;
    });

    window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
        if (e.key === "Shift" || e.code === "ShiftLeft" || e.code === "ShiftRight") isShiftHeld = false;
        const k = mapKey(e);
        if (k && keys.hasOwnProperty(k)) keys[k] = false;
    });

    let spoofedX = 0;
    let spoofedY = 0;
    let isTeleportSpoofActive = false;

    window.teleportPlayer = function(x, y) {
        let myUuid = null;
        try {
            if (window.GAME && window.GAME.myUuid) {
                myUuid = window.GAME.myUuid;
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        if (!myUuid || window.activeGameWorkers.length === 0) {
            return;
        }

        spoofedX = x;
        spoofedY = y;
        isTeleportSpoofActive = true;

        let payload = {
            "data": {
                "entityData": {
                    "position": {
                        "x": x,
                        "y": y
                    }
                },
                "entityUuid": myUuid
            },
            "name": "setEntityPosition"
        };

        window.activeGameWorkers.forEach((worker) => {
            worker.postMessage([payload]);
        });
    };

    let lastTime = performance.now();
    function smoothPhysicsLoop(time) {
        requestAnimationFrame(smoothPhysicsLoop);
        if (!time) time = performance.now();

        let delta = time - lastTime;
        if (isNaN(delta) || delta < 0 || delta > 100) delta = 16.66;
        lastTime = time;

        if (!speedHackEnabled) return;

        let myUuid = null;
        try {
            if (window.GAME && window.GAME.myUuid) {
                myUuid = window.GAME.myUuid;
            }
        } catch(e) {}

        if (!isTeleportSpoofActive || !myUuid) return;

        let vx = 0;
        let vy = 0;

        if (keys.w || keys.arrowup) vy += 1;
        if (keys.s || keys.arrowdown) vy -= 1;
        if (keys.a || keys.arrowleft) vx -= 1;
        if (keys.d || keys.arrowright) vx += 1;

        if (vx !== 0 && vy !== 0) {
            const length = Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
            vx /= length;
            vy /= length;
        }

        if ((vx !== 0 || vy !== 0) && isShiftHeld) {
            if (currentSpeed < SHIFT_INITIAL_JUMP) {
                currentSpeed = SHIFT_INITIAL_JUMP;
            }
            currentSpeed += SHIFT_ACCELERATION;
        }

        if (!isShiftHeld && currentSpeed > BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED) {
            currentSpeed -= SHIFT_DECELERATION;
            if (currentSpeed < BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED) currentSpeed = BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED;
        }

        if (vx === 0 && vy === 0) {
            if (!isShiftHeld) {
                currentSpeed = BASE_MOVEMENT_SPEED;
            }
            return;
        }

        spoofedX += vx * currentSpeed * (delta / 1000);
        spoofedY += vy * currentSpeed * (delta / 1000);

        let fakePacket = {
            "type": "packets",
            "packets": [
                {
                    "responseType": "updateEntities",
                    "responseData": {
                        "entitiesData": [
                            {
                                "entityUuid": myUuid,
                                "data": {
                                    "transforms": {
                                        "position": {
                                            "x": spoofedX,
                                            "y": spoofedY
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        ],
                        "entityCount": 45
                    }
                }
            ]
        };

        window.activeGameWorkers.forEach((worker) => {
            const event = new MessageEvent("message", { data: fakePacket });
            worker.dispatchEvent(event);
            if (typeof worker.onmessage === 'function') {
                worker.onmessage(event);
            }
        });
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(smoothPhysicsLoop);

    // --- ПЕРЕХВАТ WORKER ---
    let msgpackDecode = null;
    if (window.msgpack && typeof window.msgpack.decode === 'function') {
        msgpackDecode = window.msgpack.decode;
    }

    const RealWorker = window.Worker;

    window.Worker = function() {
        const worker = new (Function.prototype.bind.apply(RealWorker, [null].concat(Array.from(arguments))))();
        window.activeGameWorkers.push(worker);

        function processIncoming(data) {
            if (!data) return data;
            let myUuid = null;
            try {
                if (window.GAME && window.GAME.myUuid) {
                    myUuid = window.GAME.myUuid;
                }
            } catch(e) {}

            if (!myUuid || !speedHackEnabled) return data;

            let decoded = data;
            if (data.byteLength !== undefined && msgpackDecode) {
                try { decoded = msgpackDecode(new Uint8Array(data.buffer || data)); } catch(e) {}
            } else if (typeof data === "string") {
                try { decoded = JSON.parse(data); } catch(e) {}
            } else if (typeof data === "object") {
                try { decoded = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)); } catch(e) {}
            }

            let modified = false;

            function traverseAndSpoof(obj) {
                if (!obj) return;

                if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
                    obj.forEach(traverseAndSpoof);
                } else if (obj && typeof obj === 'object' && obj.type === 'packets' && Array.isArray(obj.packets)) {
                    obj.packets.forEach(traverseAndSpoof);
                } else if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') {
                    let label = obj.name || obj.responseType || obj.event || obj.type;

                    if (label === "updateEntities" && obj.responseData && Array.isArray(obj.responseData.entitiesData)) {
                        for (let ent of obj.responseData.entitiesData) {
                            if (ent.entityUuid === myUuid && ent.data && ent.data.transforms && ent.data.transforms.position) {
                                let pos = ent.data.transforms.position;
                                let x = pos.x || 0;
                                let y = pos.y || 0;
                                if (isTeleportSpoofActive && (Math.abs(x - spoofedX) >= 1.0 || Math.abs(y - spoofedY) >= 1.0)) {
                                    pos.x = spoofedX;
                                    pos.y = spoofedY;
                                    modified = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            traverseAndSpoof(decoded);

            if (modified) {
                return decoded;
            }
            return data;
        }

        const listenerWrappers = new WeakMap();

        const origAddEventListener = worker.addEventListener;
        worker.addEventListener = function(type, listener, options) {
            if (type === "message" && listener) {
                let wrappedListener = listenerWrappers.get(listener);
                if (!wrappedListener) {
                    wrappedListener = function(e) {
                        let newData = processIncoming(e ? e.data : null);
                        if (e && newData !== e.data) {
                            let newEvent = new MessageEvent("message", { data: newData });
                            return typeof listener === 'function' ? listener.call(this, newEvent) : listener.handleEvent(newEvent);
                        }
                        return typeof listener === 'function' ? listener.call(this, e) : listener.handleEvent(e);
                    };
                    if (typeof listener === 'object' || typeof listener === 'function') {
                        listenerWrappers.set(listener, wrappedListener);
                    }
                }
                return origAddEventListener.call(this, type, wrappedListener, options);
            }
            return origAddEventListener.call(this, type, listener, options);
        };

        const origRemoveEventListener = worker.removeEventListener;
        worker.removeEventListener = function(type, listener, options) {
            if (type === "message" && listener && listenerWrappers.has(listener)) {
                return origRemoveEventListener.call(this, type, listenerWrappers.get(listener), options);
            }
            return origRemoveEventListener.call(this, type, listener, options);
        };

        const origOnMessageDesc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(worker, "onmessage")
                              || Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(RealWorker.prototype, "onmessage")
                              || Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(EventTarget.prototype, "onmessage");

        if (origOnMessageDesc) {
            let currentOriginalListener = null;
            Object.defineProperty(worker, "onmessage", {
                configurable: true,
                get: function() {
                    return currentOriginalListener;
                },
                set: function(listener) {
                    currentOriginalListener = listener;
                    if (typeof listener === 'function') {
                        const wrappedListener = function(e) {
                            let newData = processIncoming(e ? e.data : null);
                            if (e && newData !== e.data) {
                                let newEvent = new MessageEvent("message", { data: newData });
                                return listener.call(this, newEvent);
                            }
                            return listener.call(this, e);
                        };
                        origOnMessageDesc.set.call(this, wrappedListener);
                    } else {
                        origOnMessageDesc.set.call(this, listener);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        return worker;
    };

    try {
        Object.assign(window.Worker, RealWorker);
        window.Worker.prototype = RealWorker.prototype;
    } catch(e) {}

    // --- ИНТЕРФЕЙС МЕНЮ ---
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'my-cheat-menu';
    box.innerHTML = `
        <div id="menu-header" style="cursor: move; background: #222; padding: 5px 10px; margin: -12px -12px 10px -12px; border-top-left-radius: 6px; border-top-right-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
            <span>Zer0xMenu <span style="color: #87CEEB;">2.0 Release</span></span>
            <span id="client-settings-gear" title="Client Settings" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
        </div>

        <div id="main-menu-content" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>Speed + NoClip</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="speedhack-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.speedHack ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="Speed + NoClip" title="Настройки Speed + NoClip" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>AdBlock</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="adblock-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.adBlock ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="AdBlock" title="Настройки AdBlock" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>GUI</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" class="custom-toggle" style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="GUI" title="Настройки GUI" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>FreePlace</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="freeplace-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.freePlace ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="FreePlace" title="Настройки FreePlace" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>FPS Boost</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" class="custom-toggle" style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="FPS Boost" title="Настройки FPS Boost" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>Mini Map</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" class="custom-toggle" style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="Mini Map" title="Настройки Mini Map" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                <label style="flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                    <span>Zoom</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" id="zoom-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.zoom ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                </label>
                <span class="setting-gear" data-target="Zoom" title="Настройки Zoom" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
            </div>

            <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;">
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #87CEEB; font-weight: bold;">Teleport</span>
                    <span id="tp-settings-gear" title="Teleport Settings" style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; color: #888; transition: color 0.2s;">⚙️</span>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px;">
                    <input type="number" id="tp-x" placeholder="X" style="width: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: inherit; padding: 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: inherit;">
                    <input type="number" id="tp-z" placeholder="Z" style="width: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: inherit; padding: 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: inherit;">
                </div>
                <button id="tp-btn" style="background: #333; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 6px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; transition: background 0.2s;">Полетели!</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="client-settings-content" style="display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px;">
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 2px;">
                <button id="back-from-client" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: inherit; border: none; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;">← Назад</button>
                <span style="font-size: 15px; color: #87CEEB; font-weight: bold;">Client Settings</span>
            </div>

            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px;">
                <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span>Шрифт:</span>
                    <select id="client-font-select" style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); color: inherit; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: bold;">
                        <option value="cursive" ${currentConfig.font === 'cursive' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cursive (Default)</option>
                        <option value="minecraft" ${currentConfig.font === 'minecraft' ? 'selected' : ''}>Minecraft</option>
                        <option value="monospace" ${currentConfig.font === 'monospace' ? 'selected' : ''}>Monospace</option>
                        <option value="sans-serif" ${currentConfig.font === 'sans-serif' ? 'selected' : ''}>Sans-Serif</option>
                        <option value="serif" ${currentConfig.font === 'serif' ? 'selected' : ''}>Serif</option>
                        <option value="custom" ${currentConfig.font === 'custom' ? 'selected' : ''}>Свой шрифт (URL)</option>
                    </select>
                </label>

                <div id="custom-font-container" style="display: ${currentConfig.font === 'custom' ? 'flex' : 'none'}; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;">
                    <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #aaa;">Ссылка на .ttf файл шрифта:</span>
                    <input type="text" id="client-custom-font-url" value="${currentConfig.customFontUrl}" placeholder="https://example.com/font.ttf" style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: inherit; padding: 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit;">
                </div>

                <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span>Размер меню: <span id="scale-value">${currentConfig.menuScale}</span>x</span>
                    <input type="range" id="client-scale-range" min="0.7" max="1.5" step="0.05" value="${currentConfig.menuScale}" style="cursor: pointer; width: 100px;">
                </label>

                <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span>Цвет фона меню:</span>
                    <input type="color" id="client-bg-color" value="${currentConfig.bgColor}" style="cursor: pointer; border: none; width: 28px; height: 22px; background: none;">
                </label>

                <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span>Цвет текста:</span>
                    <input type="color" id="client-text-color" value="${currentConfig.textColor}" style="cursor: pointer; border: none; width: 28px; height: 22px; background: none;">
                </label>

                <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span>Цвет тумблеров:</span>
                    <input type="color" id="client-accent-color" value="${currentConfig.accentColor}" style="cursor: pointer; border: none; width: 28px; height: 22px; background: none;">
                </label>

                <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px;">
                    <button id="save-config-btn" style="flex: 1; background: rgba(0,123,255,0.4); color: inherit; border: 1px solid rgba(0,123,255,0.6); padding: 8px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; transition: background 0.2s;">Сохранить</button>
                    <button id="reset-config-btn" style="flex: 1; background: rgba(220,50,50,0.3); color: inherit; border: 1px solid rgba(220,50,50,0.5); padding: 8px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; transition: background 0.2s;">Сбросить</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="param-settings-content" style="display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                <button id="back-from-param" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: inherit; border: none; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px;">← Назад</button>
                <span id="param-settings-title" style="font-size: 13px; color: #87CEEB; font-weight: bold;">Parameter Settings</span>
            </div>

            <div id="param-dynamic-container" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;">
                <div id="gui-specific-settings" style="display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;">
                    <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <span style="font-size: 12px;">Убрать значок магазина</span>
                        <input type="checkbox" id="hide-shop-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.hideShopIcon ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                    </label>
                    <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <span style="font-size: 12px;">Убрать текст сверху</span>
                        <input type="checkbox" id="hide-toptext-toggle" class="custom-toggle" ${currentConfig.hideTopText ? 'checked' : ''} style="cursor: pointer; width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: ${currentConfig.accentColor};">
                    </label>
                </div>
                <div id="param-default-placeholder" style="font-size: 12px; color: #888; padding: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 4px; text-align: center;">
                    Дополнительные настройки для этого пункта появятся позже.
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="settings-menu-content" style="display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                <button id="back-to-main" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: inherit; border: none; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px;">← Назад</button>
                <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #87CEEB; font-weight: bold;">Teleport Settings</span>
            </div>
            <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6;">
                <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #888;">ПКМ Телепорт (временно недоступно)</span>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pearl-tp-toggle" disabled style="cursor: not-allowed; width: 16px; height: 16px;">
            </label>
            <label style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6;">
                <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #888;">Телепорт по миникарте (временно недоступно)</span>
                <input type="checkbox" id="minimap-tp-toggle" disabled style="cursor: not-allowed; width: 16px; height: 16px;">
            </label>
        </div>
    `;

    box.style.cssText = `display: block; position: fixed; top: 50px; left: 50px; width: 400px; min-height: 490px; background: ${currentConfig.bgColor}; color: ${currentConfig.textColor}; z-index: 999999; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: ${getActiveFontFamily()}; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: scale(${currentConfig.menuScale}); transform-origin: top left;`;

    box.onclick = (e) => e.stopPropagation();
    box.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();
    box.onmouseup = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

    // --- МОНТИРОВАНИЕ В DOM И ОБРАБОТЧИКИ СОБЫТИЙ ---
    function initMenuEvents() {
        const header = document.getElementById('menu-header');
        let isDragging = false;
        let startX, startY;

        if (header) {
            header.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                if (e.button === 0 || e.button === 2) {
                    isDragging = true;
                    startX = e.clientX - (box.offsetLeft * currentConfig.menuScale);
                    startY = e.clientY - (box.offsetTop * currentConfig.menuScale);
                    e.preventDefault();
                }
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            if (e.buttons === 0) {
                isDragging = false;
                return;
            }
            box.style.left = ((e.clientX - startX) / currentConfig.menuScale) + 'px';
            box.style.top = ((e.clientY - startY) / currentConfig.menuScale) + 'px';
        });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', function(e) {
            if (e.button === 0 || e.button === 2) {
                isDragging = false;
            }
        });

        const fontSelect = document.getElementById('client-font-select');
        const customFontContainer = document.getElementById('custom-font-container');
        const customFontUrlInput = document.getElementById('client-custom-font-url');
        const bgColorInput = document.getElementById('client-bg-color');
        const textColorInput = document.getElementById('client-text-color');
        const accentColorInput = document.getElementById('client-accent-color');
        const scaleRange = document.getElementById('client-scale-range');
        const scaleValueText = document.getElementById('scale-value');

        const speedToggle = document.getElementById('speedhack-toggle');
        const adToggle = document.getElementById('adblock-toggle');
        const freePlaceToggle = document.getElementById('freeplace-toggle');
        const zoomToggle = document.getElementById('zoom-toggle');
        const hideShopToggle = document.getElementById('hide-shop-toggle');
        const hideTopTextToggle = document.getElementById('hide-toptext-toggle');

        const mainMenuContent = document.getElementById('main-menu-content');
        const clientGear = document.getElementById('client-settings-gear');
        const clientSettingsContent = document.getElementById('client-settings-content');
        const backFromClientBtn = document.getElementById('back-from-client');

        if (clientGear) {
            clientGear.addEventListener('mouseover', () => clientGear.style.color = '#fff');
            clientGear.addEventListener('mouseout', () => clientGear.style.color = '#888');
            clientGear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'none';
                clientSettingsContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        }

        if (backFromClientBtn) {
            backFromClientBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                clientSettingsContent.style.display = 'none';
                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        }

        const paramSettingsContent = document.getElementById('param-settings-content');
        const paramSettingsTitle = document.getElementById('param-settings-title');
        const backFromParamBtn = document.getElementById('back-from-param');
        const guiSpecificSettings = document.getElementById('gui-specific-settings');
        const paramDefaultPlaceholder = document.getElementById('param-default-placeholder');

        document.querySelectorAll('.setting-gear').forEach(gear => {
            gear.addEventListener('mouseover', () => gear.style.color = '#fff');
            gear.addEventListener('mouseout', () => gear.style.color = '#888');
            gear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const targetName = gear.getAttribute('data-target');
                if (paramSettingsTitle) paramSettingsTitle.textContent = targetName;

                if (targetName === 'GUI') {
                    if (guiSpecificSettings) guiSpecificSettings.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (paramDefaultPlaceholder) paramDefaultPlaceholder.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    if (guiSpecificSettings) guiSpecificSettings.style.display = 'none';
                    if (paramDefaultPlaceholder) paramDefaultPlaceholder.style.display = 'block';
                }

                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'none';
                paramSettingsContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        });

        if (backFromParamBtn) {
            backFromParamBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                paramSettingsContent.style.display = 'none';
                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        }

        if (fontSelect) {
            fontSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                customFontContainer.style.display = e.target.value === 'custom' ? 'flex' : 'none';
            });
        }

        if (scaleRange && scaleValueText) {
            scaleRange.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                scaleValueText.textContent = e.target.value;
            });
        }

        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-config-btn');
        if (saveBtn) {
            saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                currentConfig.font = fontSelect.value;
                currentConfig.customFontUrl = customFontUrlInput.value.trim();
                currentConfig.bgColor = bgColorInput.value;
                currentConfig.textColor = textColorInput.value;
                currentConfig.accentColor = accentColorInput.value;
                currentConfig.menuScale = parseFloat(scaleRange.value);

                if (speedToggle) currentConfig.speedHack = speedToggle.checked;
                if (adToggle) currentConfig.adBlock = adToggle.checked;
                if (freePlaceToggle) currentConfig.freePlace = freePlaceToggle.checked;
                if (zoomToggle) currentConfig.zoom = zoomToggle.checked;
                if (hideShopToggle) currentConfig.hideShopIcon = hideShopToggle.checked;
                if (hideTopTextToggle) currentConfig.hideTopText = hideTopTextToggle.checked;

                applyCustomHiding();

                if (currentConfig.font === 'custom' && currentConfig.customFontUrl) {
                    const dynStyle = document.createElement('style');
                    dynStyle.innerHTML = `
                        @font-face {
                            font-family: 'UserCustomFont';
                            src: url('${currentConfig.customFontUrl}') format('truetype');
                        }
                    `;
                    document.head.appendChild(dynStyle);
                }

                box.style.fontFamily = getActiveFontFamily();
                box.style.backgroundColor = currentConfig.bgColor;
                if (header) header.style.backgroundColor = currentConfig.bgColor;
                box.style.color = currentConfig.textColor;
                box.style.transform = `scale(${currentConfig.menuScale})`;

                document.querySelectorAll('.custom-toggle').forEach(el => {
                    el.style.accentColor = currentConfig.accentColor;
                });

                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('zer0x_client_config', JSON.stringify(currentConfig));
                } catch(e) {}

                alert('Настройки успешно сохранены!');
            });
        }

        const resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-config-btn');
        if (resetBtn) {
            resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                localStorage.removeItem('zer0x_client_config');
                location.reload();
            });
        }

        const tpGear = document.getElementById('tp-settings-gear');
        const settingsMenuContent = document.getElementById('settings-menu-content');
        const backToMainBtn = document.getElementById('back-to-main');

        if (tpGear) {
            tpGear.addEventListener('click', () => {
                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'none';
                settingsMenuContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        }

        if (backToMainBtn) {
            backToMainBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                settingsMenuContent.style.display = 'none';
                mainMenuContent.style.display = 'flex';
            });
        }

        const inputX = document.getElementById('tp-x');
        const inputZ = document.getElementById('tp-z');
        const tpBtn = document.getElementById('tp-btn');

        function executeTeleport() {
            const x = parseFloat(inputX.value);
            const z = parseFloat(inputZ.value);
            if (!isNaN(x) && !isNaN(z)) {
                window.teleportPlayer(x, z);
            }
        }

        if (tpBtn) tpBtn.addEventListener('click', executeTeleport);

        if (speedToggle) {
            speedToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                speedHackEnabled = e.target.checked;
                currentConfig.speedHack = e.target.checked;
            });
        }

        if (freePlaceToggle) {
            freePlaceToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                freePlaceEnabled = e.target.checked;
                currentConfig.freePlace = e.target.checked;
            });
        }

        if (zoomToggle) {
            zoomToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                zoomEnabled = e.target.checked;
                currentConfig.zoom = e.target.checked;
            });
        }

        if (hideShopToggle) {
            hideShopToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                currentConfig.hideShopIcon = e.target.checked;
                applyCustomHiding();
            });
        }

        if (hideTopTextToggle) {
            hideTopTextToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                currentConfig.hideTopText = e.target.checked;
                applyCustomHiding();
            });
        }

        // AdBlock logic
        let adBlockEnabled = currentConfig.adBlock;
        const adSelectors = ['.banner-ad', 'iframe[src*="ads"]', 'div[id^="google_ads"]'];
        const blockedDomains = ['doubleclick.net', 'googleadservices.com', 'adservice.google.com'];

        function removeAds() {
            if (!adBlockEnabled) return;
            adSelectors.forEach(selector => {
                document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => el.remove());
            });
        }

        const observer = new MutationObserver(removeAds);
        if (document.documentElement) {
            observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        }
        removeAds();

        const originalFetch = window.fetch;
        window.fetch = async function(...args) {
            if (adBlockEnabled) {
                const url = args[0] ? args[0].toString() : '';
                if (blockedDomains.some(domain => url.includes(domain))) {
                    return new Promise(() => {});
                }
            }
            return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
        };

        if (adToggle) {
            adToggle.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                adBlockEnabled = e.target.checked;
                currentConfig.adBlock = e.target.checked;
                if (adBlockEnabled) removeAds();
            });
        }
    }

    function mountMenu() {
        if (document.body) {
            document.body.appendChild(box);
            initMenuEvents();

            const scanner = setInterval(() => {
                let hasUuid = false;
                try {
                    if (window.GAME && window.GAME.myUuid) {
                        hasUuid = true;
                    }
                } catch(e) {}

                if (hasUuid) {
                    window.teleportPlayer(0, 0);
                    clearInterval(scanner);
                }
            }, 500);
        } else {
            window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', mountMenu, { once: true });
        }
    }

    mountMenu();

    box.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.code === 'Insert') {
            box.style.display = box.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
        }
        if (e.code === 'Escape') {
            box.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
})();s
